hypothesis.statement: With the store-group construct class proved inert and declaration position proved not to decide the split, the only untried class is REGISTER PRESSURE at the split point. The mechanism, measured: MWCC sinks `mt`'s home definition to just before the call (ours emits `li r29,-1` at 0x124, immediately before `sth r0,294(r30)` and `bl CritterGetDoAction`) and rematerialises the constant into the scratch r0 for the three stores; the target never sinks, so r0 stays free and its `mulli r0,r4,144` at 0x10c uses r0 where ours must spend r4 (`mulli r4,r4,144`) and then r5 (`lwz r5,292(r3)`). The function saves only r29-r31 (`stmw r29,52(r1)`), so the untried lever is to change what is competing for r0 across those five words - specifically to give the `move0 = &(...movesPtr)[...]` address arithmetic a form that does not want a scratch register at 0x10c-0x11c, which is the only other consumer in the window.
